bloques.titulo: The rules of the temporum consecutio with past
texto: **Contemporaneidad / posterioridad**: «Pensavo che venisse» (I thought he was coming / coming); «Speravo che vincesse» (I expected him to win).
**Anterioridad en el pasado**: «Pensavo che fosse venuto» (I thought I had come); «Credevo che avessero capito» (I thought they had understood).

It is built with the indefect congiuntive of the auxiliary (**avessi**, **avesse**, **avessimo**, **aveste**, **avessero** / **fossi**, **fosse**, **fossimo**, **foste**, **fossero**) plus the last participle.

frases.it: Perché ieri non c'era nessuno all'incontro delle tre?
frases.es: ¿Por qué ayer no había nadie en el encuentro de las tres?
frases.en: Why was there no one at the 3: 00 meeting yesterday?
analisis: Why there was no one yesterday?
at the meeting of the three

frases.it: Credevo che il presidente avesse rinviato la seduta al giorno seguente.
frases.es: Creía que el presidente había aplazado la sesión al día siguiente.
frases.en: I thought the president had postponed the meeting the next day.
analisis: credevo che il presidente avesse rinviato
I thought the president had postponed.

frases.it: E tutti gli altri membri della commissione cosa pensavano?
frases.es: ¿Y todos los demás miembros de la comisión qué pensaban?
frases.en: What did all the other members of the committee think?

frases.it: Temevano che fosse successo un grave imprevisto e sono tornati nei loro uffici.
frases.es: Temían que hubiera sucedido un grave imprevisto y regresaron a sus despachos.
frases.en: They were afraid that a serious unintended event would have occurred and returned to their offices.
analisis: They were afraid it would have happened.

bloques.pregunta: What subjunctive time does a subordinate require that denote an earlier fact regarding a main verb in imperfect?

opciones.explicacion: «Credevo che avesse già firmato il contratto».
It can only depend on a present or future time in the matrix phrase.
It does not comply with the formal regime of subordination with verbs of opinion.

bloques.frase: Speravo che voi ___ trovato un accordo vantaggioso prima del voto.

opciones.explicacion: «avere»'s imperfect congiuntive with «voi» integrated into the past sequence.
Subjunctive present incompatible with subordination to a matrix verb in past.
Improper conditional mode in the complete proposal.

bloques.frase: Pensavano che il relatore avesse già concluso la presentazione.

opciones.texto: The rapporteur had completed his presentation before the moment they formulated that thought.
The speaker will begin his speech in three quarters of an hour
opciones.explicacion: It misleads action to the future.

opciones.texto: The rapporteur is speaking at that very moment before the entire auditorium.
opciones.explicacion: It combines the previous with the contemporaneity.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way for «I was afraid they'd come out.»?

opciones.explicacion: Wrong «avere» assistant for inaccusative verbs of movement.
Time discord present after main verb in past.

bloques.frase: Non sapevo che Maria ___ già tornata dalla Germania il mese scorso.

opciones.explicacion: Congiuntivo trapassate with «essere» concorded to feminine singular.
A present form of subjunctive incompatible with the past chronological framework.
Indicative mode that does not respect the formal regime after epistemic denial.

bloques.frase: Credevo che avesse capito la situazione
bloques.traduccion: I thought you understood the situation.
bloques.explicacion: Order the phrase with congiuntive trapassate.

bloques.pregunta: What value does «Pensavo che arrivasse oggi» transmit against «Pensavo che fosse arrivato oggi»?

opciones.texto: «Arrivasse» indicates simularity in the past, while «fosse arrivato» states that the journey had already ended
Both sentences are perfectly interchangeable without change in nuance or time
opciones.explicacion: It doesn't care about the difference between continuous and perfect appearance.

opciones.texto: «Arrivasse» expresa certeza absoluta y «fosse arrivato» denota una orden obligatoria
opciones.explicacion: There is no mandate in either of the two constructions.

intro: If the main prayer expresses doubt, belief, desire or fear through a time of past (imfect, prossimo passate or remote passage), the Italian «consecutio temporum»'s golden rule prescribes: congiuntive imperfect for simultaneous or future actions, and congiuntive trapassate for previous events.
